findings.evidence: grep 'Provenance' TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AdicSpace: hits in Cont/Basic.lean:59, PatchPresentation.lean:47, SpvOfIdeal/Spectral.lean:86 (plus 'Relation to the AINTLIB formalisation' at SpvOfIdeal/Basic.lean:31); no AINTLIB or mathlib4 mention anywhere in RationalSubset.lean.
findings.fix: Add a `## Provenance` section in the module docstring in the form already used in this directory, e.g. Cont/Basic.lean:59-66: name AINTLIB (`github.com/CBirkbeck/AINTLIB`, Apache-2.0), branch `dev/adic-spaces`, commit `37bbdaeb9ad9e3bc9f0d660feadc2779e455a91c`, file `RationalSubsets.lean`, and state whether it was ported, consulted, or not used, plus how the definition differs. If mathlib4#42315 carries rational-subset material, say the same about it (Spa/Basic.lean:34-37 already contrasts its `SpaPoint`).
findings.issue: No statement of the file's relationship to the prior Lean formalization of this exact material. The roadmap's 'Existing Lean work' table lists AINTLIB `projects/AdicSpaces/.../RationalSubsets.lean` as the existing source for the 'Spa and rational subsets' row this PR advances (roadmap README.md:936), and AINTLIB demonstrably has rational-subset material (SpvOfIdeal/Spectral.lean:112 cites its `SpvAI.exists_rationalSubset_microbial`). A reader cannot tell whether this is a port, an adaptation, or independent.

summary: Wedhorn is cited precisely and correctly (v1, Def 7.29 / Rem 7.30(5) / Thm 7.35), and the formal dependencies are in-repo with their own porting credit. The one gap is the missing provenance note against AINTLIB's RationalSubsets.lean, the prior formalization the roadmap names for exactly this target and which every neighbouring file in this directory addresses.
